GC_event_counts_limitation: Not instrumented; gc.time() reports time, not event counts. No event counts inferred.
GC_elapsed_resolution_limitation: Public GC timer resolution can underestimate elapsed time.
GC_through_pre_receipt_scope: Starts before package load, ends before small final receipt serialization. Whole-worker wait4 includes that serialization.
inference_scope: Three fresh 10M replicated chr22 SNP-panel pairs only; no whole-genome/indel/multiallelic performance extrapolation.
